lobby.title: X01 Lobby
lobby.joinDesc: Enter a friend's lobby code (2–4 digits, dash, 2–4 digits).
lobby.onlineMenuLead: Join with a code or create a new lobby for friends.
lobby.needMore: Add at least one more player to continue.
lobby.needAllReady: All players must mark themselves ready before the host can continue.
lobby.noFriends: No friends yet — add a guest player below.

errors.lobby-create-failed: Could not create lobby. Try again.
errors.lobby-join-failed: Lobby not found or already started.
errors.lobby-invalid-code: Enter a valid code in the format 12-3456.
errors.lobby-setup-failed: Could not save throw order or starting scores.
errors.lobby-setup-invalid-score: Enter a valid starting score between 2 and 999.
errors.player-unavailable: This player is already in a lobby or match.
errors.lobby-invite-required: Online lobbies require an invite — the player must accept first.
errors.invite-offline: This friend is not online right now.
errors.invite-unavailable: This friend is in an active match and cannot be invited.
errors.invite-not-friend: You can only invite accepted friends.
errors.invite-already-in-lobby: This friend is already in your lobby.
errors.already-in-lobby: You are already in a lobby — returned to your current session.

lobby.step1Lead: Play online with a lobby code or set up a local match on this device.
lobby.step2Lead: Fine-tune legs, sets, and scoring rules before you throw.
lobby.step3Lead: Pick the throw order and optional custom starting scores before the leg begins.
lobby.firstThrowerHint: Tap the player who opens this leg.
lobby.throwOrderHint: Use the arrows to set who throws first, second, and so on.
lobby.customStartingPointsHint: Default is {points}. Enable custom score per player if needed.
lobby.guestLead: The host is setting up players and match settings.
lobby.guestWaitingDesc: You will be taken to the match automatically when the host starts the game.
lobby.activeLobbyDesc: You have an active {mode} lobby in another tab, window, or browser. Close it there or return to it — you cannot start a new one here.
lobby.activeLobbyBanner: You have an open {mode} lobby in another tab, window, or browser.
lobby.activeMatchDesc: You have an active {mode} match in another tab, window, or browser. Return to it to keep playing — you cannot start a new session here.
lobby.activeMatchBanner: You have an active {mode} match in another tab, window, or browser.
lobby.activeMatchHintHost: Return to your match to continue scoring, or leave from that session to end it.
lobby.activeMatchHintGuest: Return to the match to keep playing, or leave from that session if you are done.
lobby.activeLobbyHintHost: To start fresh, open your lobby and leave — that closes it for everyone.
lobby.activeLobbyHintGuest: Wait for the host to start, or leave the lobby from the other session.
lobby.onlineDesc: Share a lobby code and wait for opponents to join.
lobby.localDesc: Same board, pass-and-play with friends or guests.
lobby.localPlayersHint: Add or change players at any time — everyone shares this screen.
lobby.guestEmailHint: With an email, the guest can receive match statistics later. Saving the guest stores their name for next time.
lobby.inviteFriendsHint: Invite online friends — even if they are in another lobby. They get a notification and can join with one tap. Players in an active match cannot be invited.
lobby.inviteReceivedBody: {name} invited you to an X01 lobby.
lobby.noOnlineFriends: No friends online right now — share the lobby code instead.
lobby.formatBestOfHint: Best of N — first to win a majority of legs (e.g. best of 3 = first to 2 legs).
lobby.formatFirstToHint: First to N — first player to reach the leg count wins the set.
lobby.legsHint: Legs within a set — win enough to take the set.
lobby.setsHint: Sets in the match — win enough sets to win the match.
lobby.startStraightHint: Straight in (SI) — any segment opens scoring.
lobby.startDoubleHint: Double in (DI) — first scoring dart must be a double.
lobby.finishStraightHint: Straight out (SO) — any finish to exactly zero wins the leg.
lobby.finishDoubleHint: Double out (DO) — winning dart must be a double (incl. bullseye).
lobby.checkoutRateHint: Record checkout attempts and successes for match statistics.
lobby.publicMatchHint: When enabled, other users can watch live scores — not the throw input.
lobby.exitDesc: Your lobby progress will be lost.

play.title: X01 Match
play.spectatorHint: You are watching a public match. Only players can enter throws.

inputMode.infoCalc: Calculator mode records one visit total (up to 3 darts) instead of each sector.
inputMode.infoQuality: Switching to calculator marks this match with a reduced stats tier — heatmaps and advanced analytics are limited.
inputMode.infoBoardReturn: You can switch back to the board pad during the match, but full statistics will not be restored.
inputMode.infoDefault: Set your default input mode in Profile settings.

calculator.hintScore: Enter visit total — max 180 points (1–3 darts).
calculator.hintInvalidTotal: This total cannot be scored with 1–3 darts.
calculator.hintCheckout: Checkout — confirm which dart finished next.
calculator.hintCheckoutZone: Checkout zone — you will confirm dart count after scoring.
calculator.hintDartCount: How many darts did you throw this visit?
calculator.hintDoubleDarts: How many darts hit a double sector?

calculatorMode.title: Switch to calculator scoring?
calculatorMode.desc: You are about to lock calculator input for this match.
calculatorMode.pointStandard: Match stats will use standard format only.
calculatorMode.pointBasic: Only basic averages and totals will be kept.
calculatorMode.pointHeatmap: Target hit maps will not be recorded for this match.
calculatorMode.pointIrreversible: This cannot be undone — even if you return to the board view.

turnHistory.title: Recent visits
turnHistory.viewOnly: Only your own visits can be edited

turnEdit.title: Edit {name}'s visit
turnEdit.desc: Adjust dart scores — remaining totals recalculate instantly.
turnEdit.calcDesc: Enter the visit total (max 180) — remaining scores update instantly.

timer.label: {name}'s turn — {time} remaining
timer.timeoutDesc: You can wait another 3 minutes for them to return, or end the match now.
timer.endNote: Ending the match deletes it immediately. No results or statistics will be saved.

chat.title: Match chat
chat.readonly: Spectators can read chat but cannot post.

errors.throw-failed: Could not record that throw. Try again.
errors.throw-forbidden: You cannot record throws right now.
errors.calculator-mode-active: Calculator input is active — switch to board or use the calculator pad.
errors.calculator-mode-locked: Calculator mode is locked — use the calculator pad.
errors.board-mode-failed: Could not switch to board input.
errors.timer-extend-failed: Could not extend the turn timer.

matchGone.title: Match no longer exists
matchGone.desc: This match was ended before completion. Nothing was saved to your statistics.
matchGone.timeoutDesc: The match was closed because a player ran out of time. No results were saved.
matchGone.allLeftDesc: All other players left the match. It was closed without saving any results.
matchGone.note: Abandoned matches are not recorded in your statistics.
